disc.delta_one_sentence: MLNeedle is a pure evaluation of cross-lingual needle retrieval on dense full-attention LLMs with no training signal or state model, whereas Text A proposes a training objective that aligns per-head Gated-DeltaNet recurrent-state deltas across parallel translation spans (with a decay-free bilinear-pooling control isolating the recurrence-aware write, a language-marginal placebo, and gradient-free D-zero/ridge-transport/swap state interventions) and measures it with a surface-disjoint cross-lingual MQAR instrument on hybrid SWA-512+GDN models where beyond-window recall is state-carried by construction; the only shared element is the cross-lingual key-value retrieval task framing.

judges.fatal_defect: The training objective leaks the shared prefix, so the headline contrast does not measure translation equivariance. With per-head scalar decay, D(a|c) = S(c+a) - S(c) contains the term (prod_t alpha_t) S(c) prod_t (I - beta_t k_t k_t^T) - S(c), which is identical for a^A and a^B regardless of content; the translation pair is the only in-batch pair sharing S(c) (bitwise identical by construction) while every negative sits behind its own prefix. L_eq and L_nce are therefore minimizable by shrinking E-head write strength and tuning the decay gate alpha with zero equivariance, the ||D|| shrink kill does not fire because the prefix term inflates ||D||, A2's pooling P(a) = sum beta_t v_t k_t^T has no S(c) term so A1 - A2 >= 5 is exactly what the shortcut produces, and the P2 swap criterion is a monotone function of cos(D^A, D^B), the quantity A1 trains on directly. Compounding this, the phase-0 gate that licenses phase 1 rests on a matched-pair premise the primary sources contradict: the Olmo-Hybrid-7B card reports the Olmo 3 32B data mix, a cosine (not piecewise) LR schedule, 5.50T vs 5.93T tokens, width 3840/30 heads vs 4096/32, checkpoint merging, and NoPE attention (rope_theta null) vs RoPE/YaRN in the 8 shared full-attention layers that Gather-and-Aggregate identifies as the recall carriers, so the P0a difference-of-differences is unidentified and P0c (ridge on 18,432-dim per-head states from ~1k FLORES+ pairs) is a gate that cannot fire. Claim scope 'architecture-causal' is also mislabeled: the only causal contrast is an auxiliary loss on a fixed 57M architecture. Caps applied: novelty coverage incomplete (arXiv API returned nothing usable; OpenReview titles unresolved; WriteSAE 2605.12770 and Procrustes-transport 2608.27115 located by the refuter but absent from closest_priors) -> <= 74; no executable pilot -> <= 79; no provider-distinct signed review -> <= 89. The summed score of 59 is below every cap, so no cap binds.
judges.highest_impact_fix: Redefine the supervised object and the negatives so the loss cannot be satisfied through prefix identity: (1) compute a decay-only counterfactual state by running the span with writes disabled (beta_t = 0) from S(c), and define the segment delta net of erase/decay, D'(a|c) = S(c+a) - S_decay(c,a), so D' contains only the span's writes; (2) draw >= 2 same-prefix negatives per anchor (non-translation spans of language B placed behind the identical prefix c, so S_before is bitwise shared with the positive and the negatives alike) in addition to the entity/number hard negatives; (3) give A2 the same prefix-conditioned treatment (pool P'(a) with the same S(c)-free construction) so A1 - A2 isolates recurrence; (4) add a pre-registered sanity check that cos(D'^A, D'^B) on the frozen hybrid is not already dominated by a prefix component (report cos of D^A vs D^{random-B, same prefix} as the floor). In parallel, demote the Olmo difference-of-differences from kill gate to descriptive: make the phase-0 kills within-model (D-zero with a matched equal-length distractor-span perturbation control, and an N-scaling/margin contrast that separates storage format from readout interference), fit the transport in dual or low-rank form with many prefixes so P0c can actually fire, add a dense-model cross-lingual EM floor to the abort gates, list the NoPE/RoPE, data-mix, schedule and width mismatches explicitly as confounds, add 2605.12770 and 2608.27115 to closest_priors, and relabel claim_scope as attachment-capability unless a from-scratch GDN-vs-softmax arm with the same loss is added.

judges.fatal_defect: The causal contrast that carries the whole claim, A1 - A2 (recurrence-aware write vs same-layer projection alignment), is not identified as written. The per-head segment delta D(a|c) = S(c+a) - S(c) contains the content-independent erase/decay term (prod_t alpha_t - 1) S(c) plus the erase of S(c) by (I - beta k k^T) products, and S(c) is bitwise identical for a^A and a^B by construction while every in-batch and hard negative sits behind a different prefix. L_eq and L_nce can therefore be driven to their optimum by the decay gate alone (shrinking writes, keeping the shared prefix term) with zero translation equivariance; the '||D|| shrinks > 30%' kill does not fire because the prefix term inflates ||D||; A2's pooling P(a) = sum beta v k^T has no S(c) term and so cannot exhibit the same shortcut, making A1 - A2 >= 5 points exactly what the shortcut produces; and the P2 swap endpoint (S_before + D^B preserves recall) is a monotone function of cos(D^A, D^B), i.e. the training objective itself. Runner-up, corroborated independently by both the identification and feasibility refuters: the phase-0 pilot premise 'same 6T mix, only difference is 24 GDN vs 24 softmax layers' is contradicted by Ai2's own model card (Olmo 3 32B mix vs 7B mix, 5.50T vs 5.93T, cosine vs piecewise LR, 3840/30 heads vs 4096/32, merged vs unmerged stage 2, and NoPE vs RoPE+YaRN in the 8 shared full-attention layers that G&A/Attention-Amnesia identify as hybrid recall carriers), so P0a's difference-of-differences cannot be attributed to GDN storage, and the P0c transport gate (18,432-dim per-head ridge map from ~1,000 FLORES+ dev pairs, 720 heads) is unfireable by estimation error alone. The pilot as specified spends 3.2 GPU-h on a kill screen whose pass/kill outcomes are not interpretable in either direction.
judges.highest_impact_fix: Redefine the supervised object and the negatives so the loss cannot be satisfied through the shared prefix: (i) supervise the pure write W(a|c) = S(c+a) - [S(c) prod_t alpha_t prod_t (I - beta_t k_t k_t^T)] (equivalently, run the span with the erase/decay applied to S(c) but the write term isolated, which fla's initial_state interface permits), and pre-register the ||W|| shrink kill on this quantity; (ii) make negatives same-prefix by construction: for each anchor c + a^A, sample >= 2 distinct language-B spans a^B' behind the identical c (from the same document/bitext neighborhood) plus the entity/number-sharing hard negatives, so S(c) is common to positive and negatives and only content discriminates; (iii) add an arm A2' with recurrence but zero initial state (S_before = 0 for the span) so A1 - A2' isolates dependence on the prefix state, and keep A2 as the no-recurrence control; (iv) replace the swap endpoint as a P2 headline with a held-out functional criterion not optimized by the loss: recall under swap on surface-disjoint keys whose prefixes were never seen in training, plus an N-scaling (N in {8,32,128}) margin contrast to separate storage format from readout interference. In parallel, relabel the Olmo pair as throughput-matched, not architecture-matched (record NoPE vs RoPE, mix, width, merging), demote P0a to a descriptive instrument result with a dense-model cross-lingual EM floor gate, and fit the phase-0 transport in dual/kernel or rank-capped (r <= 64) form with many prefixes per sentence so the >= 80% closure kill is reachable. Also add WriteSAE (2605.12770) and the Procrustes residual-patching prior (2608.27115) to closest_priors and rerun blind discrimination against 2608.27115 rather than MLNeedle.

votes.reason: No prior found that ports a task adapter/LoRA from a softmax transformer onto a non-softmax sequence operator (SSM, GLA, GDN hybrid, TTT, linearized) or that measures retention as a function of softmax coverage. Every adapter/task-vector transfer paper checked is softmax-to-softmax or diffusion: Theseus (HTML confirms ViT-B/16 variants, ViT-B->ViT-L, T5-3B->T5-Large, Flan-T5->T5-v1.1; equal layer counts; no non-attention targets discussed), Cross-LoRA, Trans-LoRA (Llama/Gemma), LoRA-X and ProLoRA (Stable Diffusion), TransFusion (same architecture, different pretraining), Gradient-Sign Masking, UpgradeBench (Qwen/OLMo), PorTAL (Qwen3->Qwen3-8B/Gemma-3-4B, labeled refit). The single cross-architecture adapter-transfer hit, A4A (CVPR 2025), moves IP-Adapter-style attention adapters U-Net->DiT in text-to-image models with trained bridging features — different domain, softmax attention on both sides, not label-free. Transformer->SSM/linear work (2404.02684, TransMamba, MOHAWK, Mamba-in-the-Llama, Attention-to-Mamba, LoLCATs/Liger) transfers pretrained weights and distills with data; none ports a task adapter or reports adapter retention; Mamba-in-the-Llama is closest in spirit (instruct behaviour carried into a hybrid) but is full distillation. Native Mamba/hybrid PEFT (2604.22127, Memba, S0 Tuning, 2411.15224, 2503.03499) transfers nothing. Residual risk: the engineering step is Theseus/Cross-LoRA algebra applied to Mamba in_proj / GLA q,v, which a reviewer could call a straightforward extension; the candidate already concedes this and the surviving contribution (coverage dose with context-length term, same-lineage windowless linearized instrument, lineage x operator 2x2) is not a recombination of published results. Coverage limits: arXiv API returned 429 on ~8 of 10 host calls (only 1 arXiv-API query succeeded; substituted 2 arxiv.org site-search pages), DDG blocked, Semantic Scholar unavailable, fEeBgr6nlZ and A4A PDFs blocked (CAPTCHA/403; judged from abstracts and CVPR poster page).

The wave-2 repair is a real improvement (iso-corpus Pile trio, teacher-relabel and KD controls, R^2 covariate), but the pilot as written still cannot attribute the predicted retention pattern to the stated mechanism (softmax coverage c, "not representational similarity") rather than to matched alternatives, and several pre-registered instruments are mis-specified against primary sources.

(1) The 340M ladder's only "held-out softmax" rung is not a softmax transformer, and the ID-2 repair introduced a new error. E2-TTT's LM mixing layer has ONE shared q_proj/k_proj/v_proj (e2_ttt_swiglu.py L159-161) feeding both the 512-window SWA branch (L305) and the TTT fast-weight branch (L373), fused by a sigmoid memory gate (L409-410; paper Sec. 4: "projects shared queries Q, keys K, and values V and sends them to two parallel branches"; config use_window_attention=true, use_memory_gate=true). The chunk output uses chunk-start weights O[r] = f_{W0}(Q[r]), so in the first 512 tokens the TTT branch is active with its learned initial state. Hence (a) the "attention-pathway q/v only" site policy is unimplementable on E2-TTT — any q/v LoRA delta also drives the TTT readout — and c=1 at <=512 tokens is false: the adapter's downstream operator is a gated softmax+TTT mixture at every prompt length; (b) P1-4 (r(short) - r(2,048-prefix) >= 0.20) is confounded by prefix-OOD of a source adapter trained on short prompts, by a denominator refit WITH the prefix, and by three chunk updates of the TTT fast weights on the distractor text; no softmax-only target receives the same prefix manipulation, so a drop cannot be read as dose. The FE-3 repair's "held-out softmax target E2-TTT@short" therefore does not exist at 340M (the fla-hub transformer is the source).

(2) The phase-0 lineage axis is mislabeled, so the 2x2 never contains a low-similarity softmax cell. The Pythia README states all suite models use the GPT-NeoX default seed 1234; pythia-160m-deduped differs from pythia-160m only in data, so T1 is a same-initialization target, not "different lineage". The genuinely different-init softmax controls (EleutherAI/pythia-160m-seed1..9, plus weight-seed/data-seed variants, same data order) exist and are omitted. "Governed by c, not representational similarity" is thus tested only at the high-similarity end; UpgradeBench's CKA-predicts-retention result (Spearman 0.74) is exactly the alternative that goes unmeasured.

(3) The central instrument T2 confounds "operator" with output-side dissimilarity and with a retrofit at the adapter sites. LoLCATs stage 2 trains LoRA on W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o — the ported adapter's own sites — and its default keeps a 64-token softmax window; the windowless ablation is worse even at 8B (LM-Eval 70.66 -> 68.78, Table 5), the best case still loses 13.8 MMLU points vs the base, and no model below 7B has been linearized. The candidate's similarity covariate is INPUT-side R^2 only, but B_T is fit to R_out*delta_S(x), whose attainability depends on OUTPUT-side similarity, which the linearization's residual error degrades at precisely the operator sites. So on T2 "operator swap" and "output-side representational dissimilarity" are the same manipulation; P0-3 (r(T2) ~ r(T3)) is consistent with both. No retrofit-matched softmax control (S + the same 40M-token LoRA(q,k,v,o) fine-tune with softmax kept, or a windowed variant) is in the pilot, and T2 alone is trained on the calibration distribution (FineWeb-Edu) while S/T1/T3 are Pile-only, biasing its R^2 covariate. A low r(T2) would be read as an operator claim — the mirror of "retrofit wins read as architecture claims".

(4) The "provably inert" random-orthogonal-R placebo is not inert by construction: it randomizes only A_T = A_S R; B_T is still fit against the task-informative target R_out*delta_S(x), and a random rank-8 projection retains the mean/massive components, so B can reproduce part of the shift. A positive result would be filed under K5 ("evaluation measures format") instead of the correct reading that the functional B-fit, not the activation-space alignment, carries the task. The permuted-task placebo is also not label-disjoint for MASSIVE intent-60 vs scenario-18 (nested labels on identical inputs).

(5) Counterfactual references are inconsistent and the controls text is false in places. GPT-NeoX has a fused query_key_value Linear(768, 2304) (no separate q/v), so the "768x768 q/v" source adapter is either a fused qkv adapter (also perturbing k) or custom-sliced. Mamba2-130m's in_proj layout is 2*d_inner + 2*ngroups*d_state + nheads = 1536(z)+1536(x)+128(B)+128(C)+24 rows, so direct copy of a 768x8 B is undefined on the C (128 rows) and x (1536 rows) sites — contradicting "direct copy defined on the whole Pile trio". At 340M, GLA q_proj is 1024->512 (expand_k=0.5), so direct copy is undefined on the c=0 rung; head geometry differs everywhere (source 32x32, startlux full-attention 4x256, E2-TTT 8x128). The c=1/24 rungs use a single-layer rank-8 fresh-LoRA denominator never validated anywhere (2604.22127 used 6 attention layers at r=16); if those cells fail the >=5 pp inclusion rule, 4 of 8 ladder cells and the within-dose morphology control (P1-2) disappear.

(6) The mechanism clause "through activation-space alignment at depth-matched sites" has no test: the generic-text KD control is listed but appears in no prediction or kill (K3 compares only to direct copy/Cross-LoRA/Theseus), so every P0 can pass while a function-level distillation with no alignment matches the port.

Net: under the identification lens the phase-0 contrast could show that ported lift collapses on T2/T3, but the pilot cannot say whether that is the operator, output-side dissimilarity from an under-trained windowless retrofit, or the B-fit doing the work; and the phase-1 dose ladder's top rung and within-model manipulation are mis-specified. Salvage: add pythia-160m-seedN as the different-init softmax cell, a softmax-kept retrofit twin of T2 (and a windowed T2), record output-side alignment R^2 as a covariate, redefine c to count all branches fed by the adapted q/v (E2-TTT is then never c=1), run the prefix manipulation on a softmax target, attach a kill to the KD control, and relabel the random-R arm an ablation rather than a placebo.

candidate.claim: A rank-8 q/v LoRA trained on a softmax transformer can be transported without target-side labels (source model present, no task inputs) onto a base of a different sequence-operator family through activation-space alignment at depth-matched sites; the fraction of fresh-LoRA lift that survives is governed by the target's pre-registered softmax coverage c(T; L_eval), not by representational similarity of the two bases — tested by holding corpus, tokenizer, token budget, and even weight lineage fixed while only the operator changes.
candidate.mechanism: Source S carries per-task LoRA factors dW_S(l) = B_S(l) A_S(l) (rank 8) on q_proj/v_proj. Label-free alignment (Theseus-class algebra, not claimed as new): run N = 2,000 unlabeled FineWeb-Edu sequences (256 tokens, disjoint from all task data) through both frozen bases; at depth-matched sites take the RMS-normed inputs to the q/v projections (what LoRA sees), mask massive-activation dims (median |h| > 50x median over dims, per 2402.17762), fit R_in = argmin_R sum ||R h_T - h_S||^2 + lambda ||R||^2 (ridge; whitened Procrustes reported), record held-out R^2 per site as a covariate; transport A_T = A_S R_in; fit B_T = argmin_B sum_x ||f_T,l(x; W_T + B A_T) - f_T,l(x; W_T) - R_out delta_S(x)||^2 with <= 150 steps, batch 8 x 256, on the same generic text. Sites fixed in advance: hybrids attention-pathway q/v only; linearized transformer its q/v (identical shapes to S); GLA q_proj/v_proj; Mamba/Mamba2 in_proj rows for C (query-analogue) and x (value-analogue). Dose: c(T; L_eval) = (1/n_mix) sum_l 1[softmax branch at l] * min(1, w_l/L_eval) — E2-TTT is c=1 at <= 512 tokens and 0.25 under a 2,048-token prefix; the primary linearized target is windowless (c=0 exactly). Estimand: held-out test accuracy under held-out prompt formats; r = (acc_port - acc_base)/(acc_fresh - acc_base) with acc_fresh the target's fresh labeled LoRA at the same sites/rank; inclusion rule acc_fresh - acc_base >= 5 pp with bootstrap CI excluding 0; content-only r_adj reported if the permuted-task placebo exceeds 0.10.
candidate.what_is_new: Downgraded per the novelty refuter: the alignment algebra is Theseus's (2602.12952) applied at new sites, cross-tokenizer porting per se is PorTAL's, and the hybrid recall-damage arm is a LoRA-level replication of QK-Restore (2606.11052). What remains new: (a) the object — a task adapter ported from a softmax transformer onto GLA / GDN-hybrid / TTT / SSM bases, which no prior transports (PorTAL's targets are all softmax incl. Gemma-4-E2B's SWA/global mix; Theseus never leaves softmax); (b) the pre-registered softmax-coverage dose with its context-length dependence; (c) the identification instrument — a same-weight-lineage windowless linearized (Hedgehog/LoLCATs-style) target that separates operator family from representational similarity, unused by any adapter-transfer paper. Byte-span anchoring with fertility as dose remains new but is demoted to a gated phase 2. No direct prior art found through 2026-09-01 under the wave-1 novelty search (9 host calls, 7 WebSearch, WebFetch on all priors) plus this repair's arXiv-API and HF-papers recency queries on adapter x {Mamba, linear attention, state space, hybrid} x {transfer, port, transport} x LoRA, which returned only native-adaptation work (2604.22127, 2506.18184, 2411.15224). Coverage limits: Semantic Scholar unavailable, DDG blocked, fEeBgr6nlZ PDF unread.

closest_priors.title: PorTAL: Portable Task Adaptation (Ramp Labs; portallib)
closest_priors.delta: Labeled 1,000-example refit per target, softmax bases only; we refit label-free onto non-softmax operators and measure a coverage dose. Its 98%/94% retention is first-party and partly shortcut-driven (portallib issues #27/#28).

closest_priors.title: Theseus: Transporting Task Vectors across Different Architectures without Training
closest_priors.delta: Supplies the Procrustes + functional-matching transport algebra we use, but only for width/depth mismatches within ViT/T5 families with equal layer counts; never a non-softmax operator.

closest_priors.title: Where Should LoRA Go? Component-Type Placement in Hybrid Language Models
closest_priors.delta: Native LoRA placement in hybrids (attention pathway wins; GDN backbone -14.8 pp GSM8K); transfers nothing; fixes our site policy and is why the GDN-site sub-prediction was dropped.

closest_priors.title: UpgradeBench
closest_priors.delta: Direct-copy retention law and annotation-free teacher relabel (R = 0.96-1.05) within transformers; learned mappings on shape-incompatible hops deferred — both are mandatory baselines here.

closest_priors.title: On the Importance of Trivial Baselines: Re-evaluating LoRA Adapter Transfer (OpenReview; PDF not read)
closest_priors.delta: Direct copy beats CrossLoRA/ProLoRA between related bases; mandatory baseline, defined on our whole Pile and 32k ladders because q/v shapes match everywhere.

closest_priors.title: Attention Amnesia in Hybrid LLMs
closest_priors.delta: Already attributes post-SFT NIAH collapse to W_Q/W_K and proposes QK-Restore; our recall arm is re-labelled its LoRA-level replication (phase 3).

closest_priors.title: LoLCATs: On Low-Rank Linearizing of Large Language Models
closest_priors.delta: Linearizes a base via attention transfer + LoRA; used here as an identification instrument (same-lineage c=0 target, windowless Hedgehog variant primary), not as a method.

closest_priors.title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention LLMs: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus
closest_priors.delta: Spikes co-vary with attention density and placement; motivates masked, normed alignment inputs with R^2 as covariate and the pas-fa-04/12/20 triplet as the fixed-dose morphology control; its released 340M suite (FineWeb-Edu 10B, identical recipe) is our iso-corpus ladder.

closest_priors.title: Universal Hypernetworks for Arbitrary Models

votes.reason: No paper found through 2026-09-01 that intervenes on the same object with the same objective: training a GDN/softmax hybrid under fork / receipt-gated affine commit / isolated set-commit semantics for tool observations and measuring the capability cost against training-free state surgery. Every close prior differs on object or objective. (a) 2607.27539 (Subtract/Transport/Replay): frozen Gemma-3/KDA, deletion guarantee via support-vector gate retrofit, explicitly training-free, no tool receipts or concurrent results; CGOS already inherits and credits its Prop. 1. (b) TreeWY 2608.20961: serving-time fork/rollback of GDN state for speculative decoding, no training, no agents. (c) HARTS 2608.28158 and Tree Training 2511.00413: train hybrids/SSMs over rollout trees produced by concurrent tool use, but both are pure efficiency (shared-prefix reuse, "existing RL objectives retain their interface"), no semantic change, no gating/isolation, no training-free comparator. (d) CommitKV 2608.07855: training-free KV-page eviction at tool-call commits in transformers, not recurrent state. (e) 2606.21562 (Compressing Observation History into Agent Memory): the nearest occupied ground - a trained recurrent transformer that compresses environment observations into fixed memory via distillation, narrowing the gap to full-history transformers - but robotics/vision, no receipt gate, no isolation, no retraction; CGOS must not be phrased as 'trained observation compression into recurrent memory' in general, only as the receipt-gated commit-vs-surgery comparison. (f) 2603.01209 (interpreter persistence as training-time semantics): conceptual sibling - 'train under the runtime semantics you deploy' - but harness-level on Qwen3-8B, no state mechanism. (g) KV Admission 2512.17452: learned write gate, KV cache only, no agents. (h) Verified Tool Calls 2608.02645 and LedgerAgent 2606.20529: harness-level receipts/postconditions, no model change. (i) HOLA 2607.02303: trained 340M delta-rule + exact cache, no agents/gating. The recombination is admittedly modest (the candidate's own what_is_new says so), and its scientific content is the P vs P+surgery vs TT vs CGOS capability comparison, which none of these papers run; kill K1/K5 are the right tests and the candidate already pre-registers them. Coverage limits: host arXiv API 429'd on all attempts; OpenReview returned unlabeled hits; Semantic Scholar unavailable; a differently-worded typed-state linear-RNN agent paper could exist unfound.

The repaired pilot contains most of the right arms but its decision rule never uses the strongest one, and its headline contrast is a stub-induced train/test mismatch rather than a test of the recurrent mechanism.

1. Strongest control present but inert in the decision rule. Section 8 names "training-free state surgery on P and on TT" as THE primary comparator and section 6 lists "TT + surgery" as an inference arm, yet no prediction (P2-P5) and no kill (K1-K7) references TT + surgery. P2/K5 compare CGOS to P + surgery; P3/K3 compare CGOS to plain TT. In a world where TT + surgery == CGOS, every stated prediction can hold and no kill fires, although the entire claimed delta (trained-in gate + isolation) would then be zero beyond truncation-aware training plus a TreeWY/CommitKV-class harness. The pilot as written therefore cannot distinguish the mechanism from its strongest control; the wave-1 identification objection 2 was answered by adding the arm, not by making it decisive.

2. G0 and the "+5 pt over P + surgery" endpoint are dominated by softmax-KV truncation, not by the recurrent commit. By the candidate's own doctor (a), and confirmed in fp64 (max|diff| = 0.0, c6_toy.py), fork/commit with g = 1 on a valid single observation is bitwise identical to plain in-place processing. P + surgery therefore differs from P only through (i) the B_obs = 64 stub in the 8 softmax layers, which P never saw in training, (ii) restore on the 20% invalid receipts, (iii) isolation on concurrent batches. Phase 0 does not decompose G0 into these components, so K1 (G0 <= 1 pt) and P2 can be driven entirely by an observation-masking/CommitKV-class KV eviction imposed on an unadapted model (2508.21433, 2608.07855). TT recovers that loss identically (K6 presupposes it), so "training-in beats surgery" reduces to "training under the test-time truncation beats not doing so" - a distribution-shift result with no content about the operator.

3. The invalid-receipt stratum is inconsistent with the stated truncation timing. The obs KV is truncated to the stub only "once the next act token is emitted", so at the decision immediately after an invalid receipt all 8 softmax layers attend to the full poisoned observation; only the 16 GDN layers are contained. Non-adoption at that decision is thus a learned property for CGOS exactly as for TT (both see the rcpt token), so "CGOS 0.0% (doctor, by construction)" cannot hold for the immediate decision and P3's >= 5 pt prediction on that stratum has no mechanistic basis. In addition, the generator conflates "invalid-receipt" with "poisoned" (20% invalid/poisoned), so every poison is harness-flagged; the stratum measures whether the model heeds a flag the harness already supplies, which snapshot/restore gives for free - acknowledged for the adoption metric but not for the accuracy stratum, where plain TT is the only comparator.

4. The only learned component - g_j = valid_j * sigmoid(W_g h_{r_j} + b_g) - is never isolated. There is no hard-gate arm (g = valid_j, zero parameters = TT + training-time restore + isolation) and no receipt-content placebo (gate on a constant or shuffled receipt embedding). NC (g = 0) tests whether any commit path exists, not whether the learned gate matters; P4's "median g in [0.3, 0.95]" shows non-degeneracy, not causal contribution. Isolation is likewise never separated from canonicalization: the sort-then-feed harness arm is run on P only, not on TT, although all arms train on shuffled arrival orders so TT + sort is in-distribution; a CGOS > TT win on the concurrent stratum cannot be attributed to isolation rather than ordering.

5. The HP-transfer justification is false on the stratum where CGOS is predicted to win. "CGOS is a strict generalization of the plain forward at g = 1" (sections 7 and 15) holds only for single observations: with two layers whose second-layer inputs depend on first-layer read-outs, the isolated g = 1 composition differs from plain sequential sibling processing by 19.7% relative Frobenius (fp64 toy), and the Set-LLM mask changes the softmax half. Doctor (a) does not cover the set-commit path.

6. Primary-endpoint sensitivity is a free parameter of the same team's generator: the observation-length distribution relative to B_obs = 64 and the fraction of later decisions that depend on observation content beyond the stub are unspecified. Short observations make the stub a no-op (TT == P, G0 -> 0, K1 fires spuriously); long ones make it bite. Both G0 and the CGOS - P gap are set by generator design, not pinned in the contract.

Consistency points that survive (checked): startlux config has expand_v = 1 (initial_state = I extraction valid) and use_short_conv = false (no conv-state leak); cited priors and E2-TTT throughput figures verified. Repair path is clear - pre-register CGOS >= TT + surgery + MDE and CGOS >= hard-gate CGOS + MDE as kills, add TT + sort-and-restore, decompose G0 in Phase 0, and either truncate before the post-receipt decision or score adoption only on post-stub decisions - but as written the pilot cannot attribute any predicted win to the stated mechanism.

Every named input is concrete and verified (all HF model/dataset revisions resolve with matching SHAs and licenses; fla v0.5.2 = 9c8e42e7...; startlux 340M config = 16 GDN + 8 softmax, head_dim 256, 4 heads, vocab 32000, 4096 positions, no short conv, Apache-2.0, trained on FineWeb-Edu at seq 4096; chunk_gated_delta_rule supports initial_state+cu_seqlens with dh0 gradients), and the stated arithmetic holds (3.3+2.6+1.8+0.8+1.0+2.0 = 11.5, not 11.6; x1.25 = 14.4 <= 16). The pilot is nonetheless NOT decisive for the claim as worded, and its budget is fragile, for three concrete reasons. (1) Statistical power vs evaluation budget: the claim's headline threshold is 'within 1.0 pt' of P (and K6 needs 1-pt resolution), but Phase 1 never states the number of held-out tasks, and the 1.0 GPU-h evaluation line is spread over ~30 arm-evaluations (15 trained checkpoints + ~15 inference-time arms) = ~2 GPU-min each; for an fla GatedDeltaNet 340M under HF generate (3-10k generated tok/s batched, ~2000 generated tokens per 4096-token agentic episode) that is only ~180-600 episodes per arm. Paired-difference SE at 15% discordance is then 1.7-2.7 pt per seed pair and the candidate's own MDE formula (2.5 x 3-seed paired SE) lands at ~2.5-4 pt, so 'CGOS >= P - 1.0 pt', K6, and the concurrent-call/invalid-receipt strata (subsets of decisions) cannot be resolved. Reaching MDE ~1 pt needs ~3,000+ episodes per arm-evaluation, i.e. ~5-10 GPU-h of evaluation instead of 1.0, pushing the plan to ~16-21 GPU-h planned (20-26 with reserve). Either the eval fits the budget and the 1-pt clause is undecidable, or it is powered and the 16 GPU-h cap breaks. Only the large-effect kill screens (K1 G0 >= 5 pt, K4 never-commit +10 pt) are decidable at this size. (2) Throughput anchors are misattributed and the budget breaks inside the cited range: E2-TTT App. B.1's '132 H100 GPU-h for 340M/15B' (=31.6 kTPS) and Fig. 5's 17.6/20.0/23.7 kTPS are for plain-PyTorch TTT/LaCT models at seq 2048 and batch 4, not GDN hybrids at 4096; the fla README rows (5.964 vs 10.815 ms) are real but measured on a GB200 (CUDA 12.9, PyTorch 2.9), not an H100. candidate.claim: In a GDN/softmax hybrid continued-pretrained under receipt-gated observation commits (each tool observation is processed on a forked recurrent state, its raw tokens survive in the softmax KV only as a B_obs=64-token stub, and its content reaches later decisions only through a receipt-gated, logged, affine commit to the persistent state), held-out tool-world task success recovers to within 1.0 pt of the unconstrained plain hybrid, whereas the identical semantics imposed at inference on the plain-trained hybrid (training-free state surgery, the TreeWY/CommitKV-class harness) lose >= 5 pt, and a truncation-trained hybrid without receipt gating and sibling isolation trails CGOS by >= 3 pt on concurrent-call and >= 5 pt on invalid-receipt decisions. The by-construction properties (bitwise abort containment, arrival-order invariance of the canonical set-commit, single-observation retraction equal to the frozen-input counterfactual of 2607.27539 Prop. 1) are Phase-0 doctors shared with the training-free control, not results.
candidate.mechanism: GDN convention per head: A_t = alpha_t (I - beta_t k_t k_t^T), u_t = beta_t k_t v_t^T, S_t = A_t S_{t-1} + u_t, read o_t = S_t^T q_t; any contiguous span is an affine map S -> Aseg S + Wseg. Token types {sys, usr, rsn, act, obs, rcpt} come from the trace format, never from content. Non-obs tokens update the persistent state P. obs-start(j): fork Q_j <- P; obs tokens update Q_j only (numerically identical to in-place processing until the receipt). Receipt r_j (exit code, schema-valid bit valid_j, byte length, hash prefix; emitted by the harness's receipted tool runtime): g_j = valid_j * sigmoid(W_g h_{r_j} + b_g) in [0,1]^{d_v}; commit T_j(X) = X(I - diag g_j) + (Aseg_j X + Wseg_j) diag g_j, so P <- P + (Q_j - P) diag g_j = P + C_j; g_j = 1 recovers plain GDN exactly, valid_j = 0 is the identity (bitwise containment); Q_j discarded; obs KV in softmax layers truncated to a B_obs stub once the next act token is emitted. Ledger: (j, C_j) for the K most recent commits, propagated C_j <- A_t C_j; retraction P_T - C_j^(T) equals the g_j = 0 state with all later (k,v,alpha,beta) fixed - exactly Proposition 1 of arXiv 2607.27539, inherited with its scope limit (indirect channel not covered; advantage over checkpoint replay is O(d_k d_v)/token cost, not a stronger guarantee). Set-commit (repaired): concurrent results fork from the same P, are processed in isolation (separate varlen sequences with shared initial_state; Set-LLM masking and shared start position in softmax layers, applied to every arm with credit), each yields (Aseg_i, Wseg_i) via two extra segment passes with initial_state I and 0, and P is updated by composing the gated affine maps in canonical call-id order P <- T_{c_m}(...T_{c_1}(P)), which is arrival-order invariant while processing on arrival; the wave-1 additive form P + sum_i (Q_i - P) is withdrawn because it scales P by (sum_i a_i - (m-1)). Per-sibling marginals are ledgered for single-sibling retraction; multi-sibling retraction recomposes from stored pairs. Training: next-token loss on non-obs tokens; the wave-1 ledger regularizer is removed (it drove g -> 0). Everything is an affine state edit between calls of the unmodified fla chunk_gated_delta_rule kernel (cu_seqlens + per-sequence initial_state). The predictive/surprise variant is removed from the claim and pilot; it survives only as a separately gated extension with a pre-registered length-matched design.
candidate.what_is_new: Downgraded per the novelty caveats: not a stronger guarantee than checkpoint replay and not the transport algebra (that is 2607.27539 Prop. 1 on a plain GDN), not order invariance (Set-LLM masking / harness sorting also give it), not containment (snapshot/restore gives it). The delta is (i) a receipt-gated commit that makes the observation's gated contribution the transported object, (ii) isolation with canonical affine composition for concurrent results, and above all (iii) TRAINING the hybrid under these semantics with the capability cost versus training-free state surgery as the endpoint. Versus 2607.27539: they audit a frozen KDA and retrofit an external memory; CGOS trains the operator under the semantics. Versus CommitKV (2608.07855): recurrent-state commit, trained in, with CommitKV-style eviction as a harness control. Versus Context-Folding (2510.11967) / FoldAct / U-Fold: the fold target is the recurrent state at a typed boundary with an external receipt as gate, no summary tokens, algebraic frozen-input retraction. Versus CoACT (2607.02911): compression into state not text; its NAP metric is adopted as a secondary endpoint. Versus TreeWY/HARTS/DeltaLog: these are the training-free state-surgery control CGOS must beat. No direct prior art found through 2026-09-01 under the coverage in the note's section 11 for a receipt-gated, trained-in commit of tool observations into GDN recurrent state with isolation composition; the recombination is specific but modest, and the scientific content is the capability-cost comparison.

But under the lens rule (refute if a paper intervenes on the same object with the same objective, or if uncertain), the candidate is a recombination of three moves that are each already published, and the candidate itself concedes it is "a design constraint plus a measurement, not a new operator":

(1) Same objective, model-side decodability preserved for independent readers: RECAP, "Train the Model, Not the Reader: Decodability Supervision for Verifiable Activation Explanations" (arXiv 2607.20379, 2026-07; NOT in the candidate's prior list) adds a decodability term to the target model's loss so designated content stays readable by auxiliary predictors, then reports every decodability number from "independently fitted fresh probes, never from the heads", includes an "impossibility control" (unread slots stay at chance), shows fresh verbalizers convey designated content truthfully (truth 0.44-0.46 vs near-zero), and probes hold AUC 0.96 vs 0.82 against adversaries. That is the candidate's fresh-monitor/held-out-legibility protocol applied to a model-side representation; the deltas left are emitted discrete tokens instead of activations, frozen instead of co-trained heads, and never-supervised behaviour variables instead of designated-but-unread slots.

(2) Same objective on NL CoT with a monitor in the training loop: "Analyzing and Improving CoT Monitorability Through Information Theory" (arXiv 2602.18297, 2026-02-20; NeurIPS-MI/ICLR-LIT workshops) rewards the policy for monitor accuracy (oracle) or CMI(output;CoT) and reports improved monitor accuracy "while preventing CoT degeneration even when training against a monitor" on test-hacking in code generation. "Reasoning Under Pressure" (2512.00218) already defines monitorability as a monitor predicting a latent variable from the trace and shows direct optimisation is unreliable; "Monitoring Monitorability" (2512.18311) already uses weak-monitor, CoT-vs-action-only protocols.

(3) Same object class (emergent/abstract code under task reward) with a fixed external anchor: "Countering Language Drift via Visual Grounding" (Lee et al., EMNLP 2019, D19-1447) uses a fixed grounding model plus LM likelihood as auxiliary constraints so pre-trained agents "retain English syntax while learning to accurately convey the intended meaning"; Seeded Iterated Learning (2003.12694), Supervised SIL (2010.02975) and Lazaridou et al. (2005.07064) extend this. The discrete reserved-vocabulary medium itself is Abstract-CoT (2604.22709), Token Assorted's VQ-VAE codes (2502.03275) and DLR (2606.29712); post-hoc quantitative decodability of latent reasoning tokens is already in "Are Latent Reasoning Models Easily Interpretable?" (2604.04902, Coconut/CODI, 54-93% gold-trace recovery via vocabulary projection).

Surviving delta is narrow: frozen-vs-co-trained reader on an emitted discrete code, never-rewarded behaviour variables as endpoint, tool-use tasks. Those are ablation cells (A3 vs A1, K4) rather than a new mechanism, and RECAP's 2026-07 fresh-probe protocol should be cited as the closest prior in place of 2606.29712. Coverage limits: arXiv API returned 429 on 7 of 9 queries from the host; ddg blocked; OpenReview abstracts unreachable behind verification; relied on hfpapers (12 queries), openreview (4), crossref (2), pre-pulled arXiv feeds, WebFetch on 20 abstracts/full texts and 2 WebSearch calls. Semantic Scholar unavailable.

The pilot cannot separate the stated mechanism (a frozen reader rewarded on 2 log-derived bits preserves grounding of all 32 code positions under stage-2 task pressure) from its strongest, cheaper control, and two of its reference quantities are set by evaluation choices rather than by the medium.

(1) No label-free anchor control. In the paper the candidate names as its lineage (Lee et al. 2019, arXiv 1909.04499, Table 2) the canonical ablation is PG / PG+G (grounding only) / PG+LM (frozen LM-likelihood prior only) / PG+LM+G / 'Agent A fixed'. Grounding alone barely countered drift (Fr->En BLEU 12.38 -> 14.20 vs 27.18 pretrained); the label-free frozen LM prior alone recovered 21.63-25.05; grounding added only +1-2 BLEU on top. Lu et al. 2020 (2003.12694) use exactly the candidate's stage-2 estimator (Gumbel straight-through; 'since GSTE only optimizes for task completion, language drift will also appear') and show that S2P - a small weight on the warm-up supervised loss, no reader at all - 'stops the language drift' at alpha >= 1, alongside a 'Fix Sender' baseline. A1 is the 'grounding only' cell. The pilot has no frozen-code-LM-prior arm, no S2P/KL-to-warm-up arm, no frozen-trace-emitter arm, and no label-shuffled placebo reader (A2 removes the reader, A3 unfreezes it, A4 replaces it with a self-report; none isolates 'labels on 2 bits' from 'frozen function fitted on the warm-up code distribution'). Worse, the candidate's own doctor I(m_train; m_holdout) <= 0.05 bits guarantees the reader's label content carries no information about the endpoint variables, so the only pathway from the reader term to m_holdout legibility is its likelihood landscape acting as a density prior - i.e. the PG+LM effect wearing a 2-bit head. Conversely, a well-fit 2-bit classifier is invariant to nuisance positions, so its likelihood constrains nothing on the ~30 positions that carry m_holdout, predicting A1 ~ A2 (K3) exactly as Lee et al.'s PG+G result did. Either outcome fails to test the mechanism as stated; the missing arms cost ~0.3-0.5 GPU-h.

(2) Counterfactual references are not matched on the mechanism's own strength. R_phi is trained on gloss NL, so it is a competent reader of the A5/A6/A7 medium, but on codes it only sees mean-pooled phrase embeddings through a post-hoc linear head, with no reader-competence gate; anchoring strength differs systematically between the NL arms and A1, so K3 ('reader inert') is confounded with 'reader incompetent on codes'. The NL ceiling in rho's denominator is measured by a fixed ~1M-param monitor at n = 200 over <=128-token traces - the wave-1 point that weak monitors understate NL monitorability was not repaired - so rho is inflated in A1's favour by monitor capacity, not by the medium. Gao et al. 2022 (2210.10760) shows optimisation against a frozen learned scorer moves the policy off the scorer's training distribution, so 'the policy cannot negotiate a private code' holds only for the 2 rewarded bits and says nothing about the other 190.

(3) 'Never in any loss' holds only for stage 2. Every m_holdout variable is a deterministic function of the [op][src][dst] slots that stage-1 CE explicitly supervises for all code arms (stale-value = src superseded; fabricated argument = src absent; dependency-step id = the src/dst id; skipped check = missing check op; premature commit = write before deps). The endpoint therefore measures retention of warm-up-supervised slot semantics under stage-2 training, not spillover to novel variables; K1's 'unmonitorable on novel misbehaviour' reading is not licensed because a genuinely novel variable would have no slot in the 64-symbol dictionary. This also makes S2P a trivial design predicted to reproduce the effect - the same collapse the candidate's K2 logic applies to A4. Finally, per Chaabouni et al. 2020 (2004.09124) new listeners pick up compositional codes faster, so the A1-vs-A2/A3 gap at n = 200 is a monitor sample-efficiency measurement (P2 concedes this), and 'drift to within 0.05 AUROC of chance' is a data-budget statement, not an information statement.

Net: both decisive positive readings (A1 > A2/A3/A4 on m_holdout; rho >= 0.8 vs A5) would be reproduced by a label-free anchor to the warm-up distribution or by reader/monitor capacity asymmetries, so the pilot as written cannot attribute any effect to a frozen, weaker, pre-committed reader rewarded on two bits. Repair: add PG+LM-style frozen code-LM prior, S2P/KL-to-warm-up, frozen-trace-emitter and label-shuffled-reader arms; add a reader-competence gate on codes; report the NL ceiling at n = 800 or with a strong monitor; restate the endpoint as warm-up-slot retention.

candidate.claim: Legibility spillover under a frozen weaker reader: in a low-rate discrete reasoning code (K=64, T=32, B=192 bits/step) whose symbol table is grounded once by a frozen, weaker, pre-committed reader rewarded on only two log-derived bits (hint-use, constraint-violation), a held-out weak monitor trained post hoc on 200 labelled episodes decodes never-rewarded behaviour variables (stale-value use, skipped required check, fabricated argument, premature commit, dependency-step id) at >= 80% of the above-chance AUROC it reaches on uncapped explicit CoT, at >= 3x fewer reasoning tokens and >= 8x fewer bits, while at the same bit budget, warm-up and reader term an unconstrained code, a co-trained-decoder code, and a fixed-schema self-report plus free code drift to within 0.05 AUROC of chance on the same variables. Grounding is created by a gloss warm-up, preserved by the frozen reader, and lost under co-training or no reader. The metered C-bit recurrent substrate and the steganographic-slack clause are no longer claimed.
candidate.mechanism: Policy pi_theta (30M from-scratch at phase 0; SmolLM2-135M @93efa2f0 at phase 1; Qwen3-0.6B-Base @da87bfb6 / Qwen3.5-4B-Base @1001bb4d at confirmation) emits, between observation o_t and action a_t, a trace z_t of T=32 positions over a reserved codebook of K=64 symbols (B = T log2 K = 192 bits), then the action in plain text (tool name + JSON args, never abstracted). Reader R_phi (20M from-scratch LM; frozen SmolLM2-135M rung in phase 1) is fitted ONCE before policy training on gloss-rendered traces -> m_train = (hint-use flag, constraint-violation flag) read from the ToyTools execution log; its K extra embedding rows E_C are initialised from mean-pooled gloss-phrase embeddings and a linear head H is fitted; then phi, E_C, H are frozen and never updated; the reader sees z only. Training has no RL at the screen: Stage 1 warm-up (identical for all code arms) does CE on codes obtained by mapping gloss-rendered teacher traces through the dictionary inverse plus CE on the action; Stage 2 removes the code teacher and trains L = L_task(action CE) + lambda_R * (-log p_R_phi(m_train | z_hat)) with straight-through Gumbel-softmax (tau 1.0 -> 0.3): the policy's downstream positions see z_hat E_pol (trainable rows), the frozen reader sees z_hat E_C (frozen rows). Because the reader never moves, the policy cannot negotiate a private code; the hypothesis is that grounding pressure on 2 bits prevents drift of the whole warm-started grounding under task pressure, so the ~190 free bits stay legible to a weak monitor on variables the reader never sees (m_holdout, never in any loss, labelled from the log only at evaluation; I(m_train; m_holdout) <= 0.05 bits enforced by a doctor). Explicit-CoT arms receive the SAME frozen reader term on their NL trace. Monitors: one fixed function class (2-layer ~1M-param transformer over raw ids + observation, action masked; plus bag-of-n-gram LR), trained post hoc on n in {50,200,800} episodes from disjoint templates; per-variable AUROC; gloss rendering is a readability instrument only. Primary endpoint rho = (AUROC_arm - 0.5)/(AUROC_NL-ceiling - 0.5) averaged over m_holdout at n=200.
candidate.what_is_new: Downgraded per the wave-1 novelty caveats: the contribution is a design constraint plus a measurement, not a new operator. Delta vs the three closest priors: (1) Verbalization fine-tuning (2506.22777, 2025-06-28) teaches NL verbalisation of hint cues with the trained cue as endpoint; here the medium is a 192-bit abstract code, the reader is an external frozen 20M model, and the endpoint is legibility on never-rewarded variables. (2) Countering Language Drift with Seeded Iterated Learning (2003.12694, 2020-03-28) preserves NL under task reward by imitation of a pretrained seed; here drift of an abstract code is countered by a frozen external reader on a 2-bit subset and measured as monitor legibility of the unconstrained 190 bits. (3) Why Struggle with Continuous Latents? (2606.29712, 2026-06; full text read this pass) builds a VQ discrete latent vocabulary with a CO-TRAINED OCR decoder, shows decodability only qualitatively, has no adversarial test, math only, no tool use; here the reader is frozen and pre-committed, decodability is a quantitative held-out AUROC with bits-matched controls, on tool tasks. Abstract-CoT (2604.22709) is arm A2, SIM-CoT (2509.20317) is arm A3, 2608.04928 (monitorability tracks task/access, not medium) is the null hypothesis. No direct prior art found through 2026-09-01 under the coverage in the note's §8 for a frozen, weaker, pre-committed external reader anchoring an abstract low-rate reasoning code with never-rewarded-variable legibility as the endpoint.

votes.reason: No paper found through 2026-09-01 that intervenes on the same object with the same objective: a TRAINED discrete reasoning code (reserved-vocabulary bottleneck) supervised with a symmetric parallel-pair invariance loss and evaluated on cross-language transfer of a trained, intervention-labelled trace monitor. Every component is individually published, so the candidate is a recombination, but not a trivial one, because the closest works each miss two or more of the load-bearing pieces. (1) Same medium, no multilingual/monitor: 2604.22709 'Thinking Without Words' trains a reserved-vocabulary discrete abstract CoT (SFT+self-distillation+RL) on English only, no cross-lingual, no monitor; 2606.29712 DLR (discrete latent vocabulary via clustering) likewise single-language. (4) Monitor side: 2605.27901 (LLM-judge fragility across 13 languages, no trained monitor, no intervention); 2608.04928 (latent-CoT monitorability via activation probes, no multilingual); 2603.28590 MonitorBench and 2502.05242 TELLME (no multilingual); 2604.04902 and 2512.21711 (probing/causal analysis of latent tokens, English only). Refuted as written: the phase-0 pilot (arms A/B/C, K1-K3) cannot attribute a Delta_L(A)-Delta_L(B) >= 5 result to "parallel translation data" rather than to (a) the training objective itself, (b) consistency regularization reaching the test-language contexts at all, or (c) invariance pressure that needs no parallel data. Source: the wave-2 write-up at scratchpad/design/wave2/interlingua-trace-codes.md.

(1) Placebo C is not matched on the ingredient the endpoint measures. The text defines C as "two English re-renderings from a committed paraphrase pool" with an "English paraphrase pool (5 per template)". Delta_L is measured on de/zh codes. In C the de/zh/syn contexts receive L_task only — exactly as in arm A — while in B they receive L_task + L_inv (pairs en<->de, en<->zh, de<->zh, en<->syn). So on the test-language codes C is identical to A, and "Delta_L(C) >= Delta_L(B) + 5" (P1) is expected regardless of whether translation signal matters; K2 ("C within 2 points of B") can only fire via spillover from English-only regularization. B differs from C in two ingredients (cross-language pairing AND any consistency regularizer on de/zh contexts). The claim's own wording — "relative to same-language paraphrase-pair supervision" and "rather than ... generic consistency regularization" — therefore rests on a control that is rigged in the hypothesis's favor. The matched placebo is per-language paraphrase pairs (en-en, de-de, zh-zh, syn-syn) with iso regularization mass per language; it is absent. Consistency regularization is known to improve robustness/generalization on its own (UDA 1904.12848; xTune 2021.acl-long.264 uses exactly this divergence device), and the label instrument y_hint = 1[a(x) != a(x - hint)] is itself an input-perturbation sensitivity measure, so a regularizer that smooths q_theta in de/zh changes the labels (fewer brittle flips) in the test language only under B — a pathway C cannot control.

(2) The primary endpoint is a monotone consequence of the training objective for the treated arm. L_inv = sum_i JS(q(.|c^A, z_<i), q(.|c^B, z_<i)) drives z^L -> z^en per instance; the executor "NEVER sees x^L", so a_t(x^L) -> a_t(x^en); the intervention (x - hint) is also rendered per language, so y_hint^L -> y_hint^en; the monitor is z-only. Hence the (feature, label) distribution in L converges to the English one and Delta_L(B) -> 0 as L_inv -> 0 by construction — the write-up's own P5 (pair agreement B >= 65%) is the same quantity. The only empirical content in the contrast is Delta_L(A), i.e. how much language leaks emergently — and that is set by the designer through the rate slack (T log2 K = 128 vs <= 30 bits, chosen "so language CAN be written into z"). The ">= 5 points" effect size is therefore a function of a free design parameter, not a test of whether translation data is an asset; there is no pre-registered slack sweep or slack-matched reference.

(3) The strongest non-parallel controls are not in the decisive pilot. Language-invariant representations without any parallel data are standard: language-discriminator/adversarial training on unlabeled monolingual text (ADAN 1606.01614: representations "indicative for the classification task and invariant across languages"; Keung et al. 1909.00153 zero-resource mBERT), and translate-test with a strong MT system (Artetxe et al. 2305.14240: "translate-test can do substantially better than previously assumed"). The write-up names both ("E language-ID adversary", "translate-test") but: E is phase 1 only; E's adversary reads "the mean z embedding" (a bag of symbols) while the monitor reads (position, symbol) one-hots, so E can be defeated by position-specific language encoding invisible to it — a designed-weak comparator; P2 is a prediction with NO kill condition attached (K1-K7 never kill on "E matches B"); and translate-test is never instantiated for the code medium (translate-then-monitor exists only for explicit-CoT arm G, K5). If adversarial invariance or input translation reaches Delta ~ 0 at equal accuracy, "parallel translation data as a monitorability asset" is false, and the pilot has no exit for that outcome.

(4) Counterfactual references are inconsistent across arms and languages. Labels are "computed per arm ... by re-running that arm's greedy policy", and y_hint's positive class mixes "rescued-by-correct-hint" (policy would err without the hint) with wrong-hint-following; its composition depends on the policy's no-hint competence in each language. Under A, Qwen3-0.6B-Base is weaker in de/zh, so the de/zh label problem differs from the English one; under B, de/zh behavior is homogenized to English, so the label problem becomes identical. Delta_L(A)-Delta_L(B) thus conflates "monitor reads de codes" with "de behavior was made English-like". The per-language ceiling M_L would separate these (a ceiling-relative gap AUROC_{M_L} - AUROC_{M_en on L} removes label-difficulty shift) but is not in the decision rule. Also, "symmetric/pivot-free" holds only in the loss form: English appears in 3 of 4 pair types, so the shared code is English-leaning by data, which specifically favors an English-trained monitor. Pair arms apply L_task to the leader only (A applies it to every member), so "iso-data" is iso-forwards, not iso-task-supervision.

(5) Minor leak to close: the monitor split is "by template family" but the write-up never states that AUROC_L is computed only on de/zh renderings of the monitor's held-out template families; if de/zh renderings of monitor-training instances are scored, then under B (z^de ~ z^en) the monitor is tested on near-copies of its training data and the contrast inflates in the hypothesis's direction. The monitor-metric doctor (hand-built code) cannot detect this.

Retrofit note: nothing here is architectural — it is a regularizer plus evaluation protocol on a fixed 0.6B policy, and the write-up correctly scopes it as "portability-protocol"; any win must be read as a protocol result.

Prior-art context for the counterfactual reference: emergent cross-lingual invariance without parallel data is reported for CODI latents (2603.08177) and is model-dependent post hoc (2608.23809); parallel data has "only a minimal effect on the cross-lingual alignment" (2603.29026); anchor tokens drive alignment and alignment does not imply transfer (mOthello 2404.12444) — arm D is phase 1 while y_hint labels ride on shared numeric literals in phase 0.

Fixes that would lift the refutation: per-language paraphrase placebo (iso regularization per language); full-sequence language adversary in phase 0 with a kill "E within 2 points of B at accuracy within 1 pp"; translate-test arm for the code medium; endpoint defined relative to the per-language ceiling; pre-registered slack sweep (T,K) with the emergent-leakage curve as a covariate; explicit instance-disjointness of monitor-train (en) and monitor-test (L) plus a permuted-label transfer doctor.

Coverage: read the full wave-2 write-up, wave-1 verdicts, D-lane note; verified 8 priors via arXiv/ACL abstract pages; 3 host-proxied arXiv API searches (adversarial x language-agnostic x reasoning; gradient reversal x cross-lingual; language-invariant x latent reasoning/CoT) found no 2026 paper already training language-adversarial latent reasoning codes — so E is an unoccupied competitor, not prior art. OpenReview/Semantic Scholar not queried.

VERDICT: inputs are concrete, but the budget arithmetic as written fails, so per the lens default this is refuted on feasibility-as-stated; the direction is repairable by re-budgeting and de-scoping phase 0.

2) Unbudgeted required runs: "lambda_inv chosen on dev by task accuracy only, all values reported" implies >= 2-3 lambda values for arms B and C, i.e. +2 to +4 full arm runs, absent from the 3.4 GPU-h. With 3 values each and the epoch fix: ~13.9 GPU-h at 150 TFLOP/s/GPU; add gradient checkpointing (likely needed to backprop through 32-64 sequential straight-through decode steps per instance plus 900-token prefill at 0.6B on 80 GB) at ~+33% compute -> ~18 GPU-h, above the 16 ceiling. 5) Decisiveness caveat (secondary): the primary K1 contrast Delta_L(A) - Delta_L(B) >= 5 AUROC points is evaluated at 1 seed with instance-level bootstrap only; between-seed variance of two independently trained discrete codes is unmeasured, so a K1 kill or pass at 1 seed is a screen, not a decisive result; the "task accuracy within 1 pp" constraint is also below the resolving power of a 3k-instance eval (accuracy SE ~0.7 pp per arm).

candidate.claim: On a discrete executor-bottleneck reasoning code with rate slack (128 bits per step against <= 30 bits of action entropy), symmetric parallel-pair invariance supervision causally lowers the cross-language transfer gap of a held-out, intervention-defined counterfactual-reliance monitor by >= 5 AUROC points relative to the iso-data no-pair arm AND relative to same-language paraphrase-pair supervision, at task accuracy within 1 pp — identifying parallel translation data (rather than emergent invariance under shared weights, shared anchor tokens, or generic consistency regularization) as a monitorability asset.
candidate.mechanism: Policy pi_theta = Qwen3-0.6B-Base (registry qwen3-0.6b-base @da87bfb6, Apache-2.0, 119-language pretraining) emits per reasoning step T=16 symbols z from a reserved K=256 code vocabulary via straight-through Gumbel-softmax (q_theta(z_i | x^L, h_t, z_<i); no RL). A from-scratch 4-layer ~8M executor E_psi reads ONLY (z_<=t, JSON history h_t) — never the language-L prose x^L — and predicts the gold JSON tool call: L_task = -sum_t log p_psi(a*_t | z_<=t, h_t), gradients to psi and (through ST) to theta. Rate slack is deliberate: T log2 K = 128 bits vs H(a_t|h_t) <= 30 bits measured in the oracle world, so language CAN be written into z. Pair arms: for a pair (x^A, x^B) sharing one execution log, a leader l is drawn per step, z^l is its ST sample, the follower is teacher-forced on z^l_<i, and L_inv = sum_i JS(q_theta(.|c^A, z^l_<i), q_theta(.|c^B, z^l_<i)) (symmetric, pivot-free); L = L_task(leader) + lambda_inv L_inv with lambda_inv chosen on dev by task accuracy only. Arms, all iso-instance/iso-step/iso-parameter (every arm processes both members of every pair): A code no L_inv (iso-data reference); B + L_inv on translation pairs en/de/zh/syn; B' English-pivot KL(q^en||q^L) with stop-grad (M-Thinker/SOLAR form); C + L_inv on same-log SAME-LANGUAGE paraphrase pairs (discriminating placebo); D + L_inv on anchor-randomized pairs (per-language opaque bijections of tool ids and field labels, numerals as words); E language-ID adversary via gradient reversal; G explicit CoT (<= 48 natural tokens, same ST estimator, beta KL to frozen Qwen3-0.6B-Base as fluency prior, no disclosure reward). syn = deterministic vocabulary bijection + word-order permutation of English (competence-equal control). Monitoring is post hoc and never in any loss: labels by intervention on the trained policy, y_hint = 1[a_t(x) != a_t(x minus hint)] (hint has randomized presence and correctness, gold independent of hint; includes rescued-by-correct-hint cases invisible to action-only monitors) and y_spur = 1[a_t(x) != a_t(x with a gold-irrelevant field perturbed)]; monitor M_en = logistic regression on (position,symbol) one-hots + 2-layer MLP on symbol embeddings, trained on English eval-split episodes only (templates disjoint from policy training), tested on de/zh/syn; Delta_L = AUROC_en - AUROC_L, catch rate at 5% FPR. Floors/ceilings: action-only monitor (Delta = 0 by construction), per-language monitors, translate-then-monitor (pinned MADLAD-400-3B-MT L->en then M_en), xTune-style consistency-trained M_en. Primary pre-registered endpoint: paired Delta_L(A) - Delta_L(B) on y_hint averaged over de/zh, instance-level bootstrap over >= 3k pairs.
candidate.what_is_new: Parallel-pair alignment of reasoning traces is published (M-Thinker CTA reward on explicit NL with an English pivot under GRPO; SOLAR soft tokens to an English pivot), post-hoc invariance on parallel traces is published (GI-SAE 2608.23809), emergent invariance without parallel data is published (2603.08177 continuous CODI latents; 2608.23809 off-the-shelf models), monitor fragility across languages is measured without intervention (2605.27901), and consistency regularization on MT-augmented inputs exists on the classifier side (xTune). The delta is the combination none of them reports: (i) a DISCRETE executor-bottleneck code with measured rate slack and no reader/monitor term, trained so that language leakage is possible; (ii) SYMMETRIC pivot-free pair invariance with the same-log same-language paraphrase control (C) and the anchor-randomized control (D) that separate translation signal from same-log equivalence and from anchor sharing, with the pivot form (B') as an explicit comparator; (iii) monitor labels defined by INTERVENTION on the trained policy (counterfactual hint reliance), never present in any loss; (iv) cross-language transfer of a trace monitor on tool-use episodes against an action-only floor, translate-then-monitor and a consistency-trained monitor. No direct prior art found through 2026-09-01 for this combination under hostsearch arXiv x4 (interlingua x reasoning; language-agnostic x latent reasoning; cross-lingual x monitor x CoT/reasoning trace; discrete-latent x multilingual x reasoning), HF papers x1, abstract reads of 2510.07300 and 2608.23809, and the wave-1 refuters' 28 URLs; OpenReview and Semantic Scholar unreachable, abstracts only.

closest_priors.delta: Counterfactual hint-reliance faithfulness protocol on frontier models. Here: the same counterfactual definition supplies held-out monitor labels for a trained small policy.

falsifiable_predictions: P1 (phase 0; qwen3-0.6b-base; en/de/zh/syn oracle world; arms A, B, C; 1 seed): Delta_L(A) in [8, 20] AUROC points on y_hint (partial emergent invariance); Delta_L(B) <= 4; Delta_L(C) >= Delta_L(B) + 5; task accuracy within 1 pp across A/B/C; AUROC_en of the z-monitor >= action-only floor + 0.10 (>= 0.80 vs <= 0.70); Delta_syn(A) >= 5.

P2 (phase 1): Delta_L(D) <= Delta_L(B) + 3 (invariance survives anchor randomization); the language-ID adversary E reaches Delta_L <= Delta_L(B) + 3 only at >= 2 pp task loss; pivot arm B' matches B for English-trained monitors but is worse by >= 3 points for a monitor trained on de and tested on zh.

P3 (phase 1, lower confidence; wave-1's unsourced '>= 20 points' is withdrawn): explicit-CoT arm G read by M_en shows Delta_L >= 10; MADLAD translate-then-monitor reduces it to <= 8 but stays >= Delta_L(B) + 4 on y_hint; the xTune-style consistency-trained M_en closes at most half of the remaining gap.
P4 (phase 1, real parallel data GSM8KInstruct_Parallel + calculator tool, en/de/zh/sw, arms A/B/C, 1 seed): Delta(B) < Delta(A) replicates with Delta_sw(A) - Delta_sw(B) >= 4.
P5: silhouette-by-language of mean z embeddings A >= 0.25 vs B <= 0.10; greedy-code pair agreement A <= 35% vs B >= 65%.
kill_conditions: K1 (phase 0, primary): Delta_L(A) - Delta_L(B) < 5 AUROC points with the bootstrap CI covering 0 at task accuracy within 1 pp — parallel supervision adds nothing beyond emergent invariance (extends 2603.08177/2608.23809 to trained discrete codes; confirms 2603.29026 at the code level).

K2 (phase 0): Delta_L(C) within 2 points of Delta_L(B) — same-language paraphrase pairs suffice; translation data is not the asset; direction collapses into generic consistency regularization and is dropped.
K3 (phase 0): AUROC_en(z-monitor) <= action-only floor + 0.03 on y_hint — the code carries no reliance information beyond the action; the medium fails for monitoring regardless of language.
K4 (phase 1): Delta_L(D) >= Delta_L(A) — the B gain was anchor-driven (mOthello extends to reasoning codes).
K5 (phase 1): translate-then-monitor on explicit CoT reaches Delta_L within 3 points of B at equal or lower total cost — the cheap alternative suffices.
K6: pair agreement >= 70% with AUROC_en < 0.65 — invariant but collapsed code.
K7: any arm's task accuracy < oracle-solvable accuracy - 10 pp after two remediation rounds — the bottleneck is not trainable at 0.6B with straight-through gradients.
candidate.cheapest_decisive_pilot: Phase 0 (<= 4 GPU-h on 8xH100, plus CPU doctors; decisive on K1-K3). CPU (~4-6 engineering days; nothing exists in the repo today): ToyTools-XL oracle-world generator (8 typed tools, 2-4 dependent calls, argument values copied from numbered context fields, hint channel with randomized presence x correctness tuned to 70-80% reliability, gold-irrelevant distractor fields, full execution log; ~300 English templates); de/zh templates translated ONCE by google/madlad400-3b-mt @fa184c67 (Apache-2.0) with chrF >= 60 round-trip check, committed as JSON; syn transform; anchor-randomized renderer; English paraphrase pool from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B @851bf6e8, committed; doctors: pair-semantics (identical logs and gold actions), rate (H(a_t|h_t) <= 30 bits; slack >= 98 bits), leakage (executor input ids contain no x^L tokens; monitor sees only z), label-intervention (gold invariant to hint removal / distractor perturbation), monitor-metric (canonical hand-built code gives Delta = 0 and AUROC 1.0; random codes 0.50 +/- 0.02), y_hint base-rate in [0.15, 0.60], Qwen3 tokenizer fertility per language measured and disclosed; plain PyTorch 2.11 + transformers + accelerate training loop with straight-through Gumbel, leader/follower pairing and executor, on the existing SIGUSR1 checkpoint/resume runner. GPU: arms A, B, C at 1 seed on qwen3-0.6b-base; 30k instances x 4 renderings, ~900 tokens/instance across steps, 2 epochs = ~108M tokens per arm (every arm processes both pair members, so A is iso-data) = 3 x 0.72 GPU-h; counterfactual labeling via vLLM greedy generation (2 interventions x 3k eval instances x 4 languages x 3 arms) 0.4 GPU-h; monitors 0.1; x 1.25 reserve = 3.4 GPU-h. Phase 1 (separately gated on K1-K3 passing; <= 12 GPU-h): arms D, E, G, B' (1 seed), second seeds for A, B, C, D, G, labeling, MADLAD translate-then-monitor and consistency-trained monitors, and a real-data A/B/C replication on GSM8KInstruct_Parallel + calculator tool (en/de/zh/sw) evaluated on MGSM/MSVAMP with a contamination probe. Confirmation (separate contract): qwen3.5-4b full FT (~40 GPU-h); Tinker Qwen3.5-4B/9B LoRA RL with sequence-level EM reward 1 - EM(z^A, z^B) (logprob-only compatible), training on GSM8KInstruct_Parallel / ReasonXL, evaluating on MGSM/MSVAMP, 5 seeds. Budget anchor: llm.c GPT-2 124M reproduction on 8xH100 in 45 min for 10B tokens (modded-nanogpt README, fetched 2026-09-01; token count from llm.c discussion #481, not re-opened) = ~344 TFLOP/s/GPU (~35% of 989 TFLOP/s H100 dense BF16); budget de-rates to 150 TFLOP/s/GPU (~15% MFU) for a HF-transformers full FT of 0.6B with ST code + executor: 1.08e8 tokens x 6 x 0.6e9 FLOP = 3.9e17 FLOP -> 0.72 GPU-h per arm; arm G ~1.2 GPU-h; LoRA would cut ~1/3 but the full-FT upper bound is budgeted.
controls: Iso-data no-pair arm A (sees the same rendered instances in all languages; the pre-registered counterfactual reference for Delta_L(A) - Delta_L(B))

Same-log same-language paraphrase pairs C (discriminating placebo; the wave-1 random-pair placebo is dropped because it is not inert — it forces identical codes on instances with different actions and conflicts with L_task)
Anchor-randomized translation pairs D (per-language opaque tool ids/field labels, numerals as words; mOthello control)
English-pivot alignment B' with stop-gradient on English (M-Thinker / SOLAR form)
Language-ID adversary E via gradient reversal (invariance without pairs)
Synthetic language syn in every arm (competence-equal control isolating surface form from competence)

Explicit CoT G on the same multilingual base with the same task loss and no disclosure reward (KL fluency prior to frozen Qwen3-0.6B-Base; fluency doctor), plus a non-iso prompted Qwen3.5-4B zero-shot reference labeled non-iso

Action-only monitor floor (Delta = 0 by construction); per-language monitors ceiling; translate-then-monitor with pinned MADLAD-400-3B-MT; xTune-style consistency-trained M_en; activation-probe monitor (2608.04928 style)

lambda_inv chosen by task accuracy only, all values reported; monitor train/test split by template family disjoint from policy training; instance-level paired bootstrap; McNemar over pairs; token counts and label base rates disclosed per arm and language; MGSM n-gram contamination probe
Strongest published baselines: 2603.08177 emergent invariance, M-Thinker pivot alignment, xTune consistency-trained classifier, translate-test (Artetxe et al. 2023, https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14240)
candidate.kevin_advantage: Modest at the pilot, by design: every phase-0/phase-1 input is public and pinned, so any lab could run it. Assets that matter: 8xH100 with the Slurm/Docker/SIGUSR1 checkpoint harness makes a 9-arm x 2-seed x 4-language design routine; Tinker Qwen3.5-4B/9B carries the RL confirmation with the EM-reward form. General Translation is an OPTIONAL upgrade only: professionally translated tool-use suites with terminology control (the scarce object; ReasonXL covers five European languages of math/general traces), low-resource and non-Latin-script coverage, and production MT as one more translate-then-monitor arm. No pre-registered endpoint requires GT data or customer content.
candidate.monitorability_and_safety: Positive: monitor portability across languages; the executor bottleneck guarantees a decoded plan is always available to a human or weak model. Risks: (a) invariance can erase language-specific cues a monitor needs (an injection written in the input language) — per-language injection detection is reported alongside Delta_L; (b) a 128-bit code with slack can carry steganographic content and cannot expose misbehaviors outside what the monitor was trained on (the VFT-style objection) — held-out labels and I(z; language) are reported and this is stated as a limitation; (c) no English gloss is used, so English-centric review is not introduced. Data rights: Qwen3-0.6B-Base, Qwen3.5-4B, MADLAD-400-3B-MT, GSM8KInstruct_Parallel, MSVAMP, ReasonXL all Apache-2.0; MGSM CC-BY-SA-4.0; MathOctopus code MIT; generated templates and translations committed under the repo license; no customer data.
candidate.negative_result_value: K1 (A ~ B): emergent invariance suffices for trained discrete codes at 0.6B — extends 2603.08177 and 2608.23809 to an intervention setting and confirms 2603.29026 at the reasoning-code level; parallel supervision is unnecessary. K2 (C ~ B): any same-log equivalence class suffices; translation data is not the asset; cheaper paraphrase pairs become the recommended regularizer. K3: executor-bottleneck plan codes carry no reliance information beyond actions — bounds the monitorability of discrete plan codes for the whole D-angle. K4: invariance was anchor-driven; mOthello extends to reasoning codes. K5: translate-then-monitor with open MT is the recommended practice with a measured cost curve. In every case the bilingual oracle world, the intervention-defined label instrument and the monitor-transfer protocol remain reusable for the G2/G13 translation-paired probes and latent-reasoning gap 2.
targets_gaps: latent-reasoning gap 2 (translation-equivariant abstract reasoning codes; monitor trained in one language tested in others)
benchmarks-eval G2 (cross-lingual translation-paired probes)
repairs_made: IDENT-1 mechanism redundancy (reader anchoring on language-neutral m makes z invariant by construction; L_inv acts only on eps slack) -> FIXED: reader term removed; executor-bottleneck code with 128 bits capacity vs <= 30 bits action entropy so language leakage is possible; iso-data no-L_inv arm A's Delta_L is the pre-registered primary counterfactual reference (Delta_L(A) - Delta_L(B)).

IDENT-2 label leakage / trained-to-disclose (catch-rate targets were components of the RL target) -> FIXED: no monitor variable in any loss; labels are intervention-defined counterfactuals (y_hint, y_spur) computed on the trained policy after training, including rescued-by-correct-hint cases invisible to action-only monitors; action-only monitor floor added (K3); explicit-CoT arm gets the same task loss and no disclosure reward.
IDENT-3 anchor shortcut (shared tool ids / field numbers drive alignment) -> FIXED: arm D with per-language opaque bijections of tool ids and field labels and numerals-as-words; K4/P2 pre-registered.

IDENT-4 undertuned comparators (English-only SmolLM2 cannot produce de/zh CoT; unsourced '>= 20 points' and 'translate-then-monitor stalls') -> FIXED: all arms on multilingual Qwen3-0.6B-Base; syn as competence-equal control; xTune-style consistency-trained M_en and translate-test added; unsourced numbers withdrawn from the claim and replaced by measured secondary predictions (P3) with stated lower confidence; 2605.27901 cited as motivation only.

IDENT-5 placebo mismatch (random-pair placebo conflicts with L_task) -> FIXED: dropped as non-inert; replaced by same-log same-language paraphrase pairs (C) as the discriminating placebo (K2) plus anchor-randomized pairs (D).

FEAS-1 hidden prerequisite on candidate 11 and zero infrastructure -> FIXED: decoupled; self-contained differentiable medium (no RL, no frozen reader, no adversary in phase 0); missing infrastructure inventoried and costed (~4-6 engineering days). ACCEPTED LIMITATION: first GPU hour is not immediate.

FEAS-5 baseline contrast without source -> FIXED as in IDENT-4.
